name: Gary's Brewery & Biergarten
description: Family-owned, dog-friendly microbrewery and taproom offering 18 rotating taps of beer, cider, seltzer, and more, all crafted on site. Features a 1.3-acre beer garden, one of the largest in Florida, with cornhole, board games, and outdoor games. Also operates Gary's Home Brew Supply store offering brewing and winemaking ingredients and kits.
